rationale: Sober, technical, dense with real terminology. Must appeal to CISOs, CTOs, and Compliance Officers of regulated EU enterprises. Avoids marketing fluff and 'pastel SaaS' clichés. Embraces a 'Sovereign Gold & Dark Slate' aesthetic.

layout_and_spacing.alignment: Asymmetric, left-aligned layouts. No centered generic clichés.
layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Use Tailwind CSS grid. Heavily utilize grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 or md:grid-cols-12 for asymmetry.

visual_enhancers.backgrounds: Use global background. Add className='grid-lines' for crosshair/grid technical background where appropriate.
visual_enhancers.dividers: Use className='gold-line' for section transitions or emphasizing key blocks.
visual_enhancers.icons: lucide-react (e.g., Shield, Terminal, Key, Network, Lock, GlobeLock, Database, FileDigit, Cpu, Server, CheckCircle2)

sections.name: Hero
sections.features: Bold statement on Post-quantum sovereignty. Live telemetry strip with static numbers. Left-aligned.

sections.name: Compliance Bar
sections.features: GDPR, NIS2, Crittografia Italiana ACN, EU Data Act, AGID badges/pills.

sections.name: Why Lattice
sections.features: 3-4 differentiators. NIST FIPS 204, BN254 ZK, X25519 onion, 2f+1 BFT quorum. Card-based asymmetrical grid.

sections.name: How it actually works
sections.features: 4-step technical flow (Domain -> Keypair -> ZK Login -> On-chain notarisation).

sections.name: Show me the math
sections.features: Terminal window showing mock curl requests to /api/pqc/info, /api/qbft/status, /api/rln/zk/verify.

sections.name: Use cases
sections.features: Clean grid (Finance, Healthcare, Legal, Public Sector, Defence).

sections.name: Pricing
sections.features: 3 tiers (Pilot, Sovereign, National Critical Infrastructure). Price: 'Su richiesta'.

sections.name: Final CTA & Footer
sections.features: 'Registra la tua azienda in 60 secondi'. Simple footer with copyright, Privacy, Terms, GitHub.

media.instructions: No external images. Rely purely on typography, CSS utility classes (.grid-lines, .terminal), and lucide-react icons.

testing.attributes: Every interactive element must include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., landing-cta-onboarding, landing-feature-pqc).

instructions_to_main_agent: Use ONLY existing CSS classes (.btn-gold, .surface, .font-display, etc.) defined in App.css and index.css.
Do not make real API calls; use hardcoded static content.
Ensure standard semantic HTML elements are used where appropriate.
In /app/frontend/src/App.js, update the routing so <Landing /> is at path '/' and move the existing dashboard route to '/dashboard'.
In /app/frontend/src/components/AppShell.jsx, update the navigation sidebar to link to '/dashboard' instead of '/' for the dashboard.
